title: On the role of intrinsic rewards in cognitive evolution: the RewardING hypothesis
title_zh: 内在奖赏在认知进化中的作用：奖励ING假说
abstract: Both the Social Complexity Hypothesis (SCH) and Self-Domestication Hypothesis (SDH) propose socio-ecological pressures as primary drivers of cognitive evolution. Yet, they struggle to fully account for the pervasive mosaic evolution of individual, social, collective cognition, and communication across species. To address these limitations, we propose here the RewardING (Reward Intrinsically Generated) hypothesis, a theory assigning key roles to structural innovations of the reward system operating alongside socio-ecological forces. We posit that across four evolutionary stages, functionally operating changes in reward circuitry have acted as a neurobiological filter constraining and modulating how socio-ecological pressures drove cognitive trajectories. In Stage 1, the conserved and experimentally grounded reward prediction error (RPE) mechanism serves as the primary evolutionary interface between the reward system and selection processes. By assigning incentive salience to both predictive cues and primary outcomes, RPE establishes the foundational capacity for anticipatory signals to acquire motivational weight and guide adaptive behavior. Stages 2 to 4 are hypothesized evolutionary transitions marked by a sophistication of this foundational mechanism. In Stage 2, innovations in reward circuitry authorize and stabilize refined representations of valued objects, whether present or absent, concrete or abstract such as internal states. Intrinsic rewards, that is, rewards partially detached from any immediate external object, are generated by: i) the matching between sensory or internal states and their representation, and ii) the process of representation itself. Importantly, representation refinement enables operational manipulation up to a high degree of complexity. Stage 3 constitutes an evolutionary leap via "symbolic matching", the intrinsically rewarding alignment between internal referents and self-generated, self-perceived signals. At this stage, an additional source of intrinsic reward relies on the matching between a symbol and an internal representation. By stabilizing these signal-to-referent associations, Stage 3 generates a versatile symbolic toolkit. Finally, Stage 4 consists of an exaptation process co-opting this symbolic toolkit to refine individual, social, and collective cognition, alongside symbolic communication. Across all stages, the general reward architecture remains conserved while exhibiting species-specific variations. Rather than replacing external outcomes, intrinsic rewards progressively expand to encompass abstract representations and symbols. Crucially, we suggest this process builds an increasingly sophisticated internal environment that modulates sensory perception via a continuous feedback loop. Through top-down modulatory pathways, an organism's representational model actively re-evaluates and filters incoming sensory inputs as well as internal affective states, continuously prioritizing perception that aligns with its internal architecture. By biasing behavioral choices among ecologically viable options, this internal filter acts as a neurobiological constraint that channels how natural selection operates on fitness, providing a unifying framework to explain the rich diversity of neurocognitive trajectories across taxa.
abstract_zh: 社会复杂性假说（SCH）和自我驯化假说（SDH）都认为社会生态压力是认知进化的主要驱动力。然而，它们难以完全解释物种间个体认知、社会认知、集体认知及沟通的广泛镶嵌式进化。为弥补这些不足，我们在此提出奖励ING（Reward Intrinsically Generated）假说，该理论将奖励系统的结构创新与社会生态力量共同发挥关键作用。我们认为，在四个进化阶段中，奖励回路的功能性变化起到了神经生物学过滤器的作用，约束和调节社会生态压力如何驱动认知轨迹。第一阶段中，经过保守且实验支持的奖励预测误差（RPE）机制作为奖励系统与选择过程之间的主要进化接口。RPE通过为预测性线索和主要结局分配激励显著性，建立起期待信号获得激励权重并引导适应性行为的基础能力。第二阶段至第四阶段被假定为该基础机制日益精细化的进化转换。在第二阶段，奖励回路的创新授权并稳定了对有价值对象（无论存在与否、具体或抽象，如内部状态）的精细表征。内在奖赏——即部分脱离任何直接外部对象的奖赏——由以下两方面产生：i）感觉或内部状态与其表征之间的匹配；以及ii）表征过程本身。重要的是，表征精细化可实现高度复杂的操作性处理。第三阶段通过“符号匹配”构成一次进化飞跃，即内部指涉对象与自我产生、自我感知的信号之间内在有益的排列。在此阶段，另一种内在奖赏来源在于符号与内部表征之间的匹配。通过稳定这些信号-指涉对象关联，第三阶段生成了通用的符号工具包。最后，第四阶段涉及一种预外化过程，将该符号工具包改造用于精细化个体认知、社会认知和集体认知，以及符号沟通。在所有阶段，总体奖励结构保持保守，同时呈现物种特异性变异。内在奖赏并非取代外部结果，而是逐步扩展至涵盖抽象表征和符号。关键的是，我们认为这一过程构建了一个日益精巧的内部环境，通过持续的反馈环调节感觉知觉。经由自上而下调节通路，生物体的表征模型主动重新评估并过滤进入的感觉输入及其内部情感状态，不断优先处理与其内部结构相一致的感知。通过在生态上可行的选项之间偏倚行为选择，这一内部过滤器作为神经生物学约束，引导自然选择如何作用于适配度，为分类群间丰富的神经认知轨迹多样性提供了一个统一框架。
